title: Loops
overview:
Loops help us repeat actions without rewriting code. In this chapter you will learn how to use for loops and while loops to repeat tasks.

Learning goals:
- for loops
- while loops
- range()

Why it matters:
Repetition is common in programming, especially for counting and processing lists.

Example:
for i in range(1, 6):
    print(i)

Think about this:
When would a while loop be better than a for loop?
exercises: Print the multiplication table of a chosen number.
Write a loop that prints every second number from 1 to 20.
